measured: routes edges on pinned checkouts, scored at the registration site against a runtime route table where one exists

handVerified.note: Registration sites are inside test functions, so no runtime route table exists; 25 edges were read against their source lines and targets. Unresolved edges in the sample were an attribute-chain blueprint (receiver-unresolved), lower-case module variables passed to register_blueprint (bound-symbol-missing) and a class-based view built by as_view (route-handler-wrapped), each stated rather than guessed.

No runtime route table without booting each integration app; 25 edges were read against their source lines and targets. Object-literal @Controller arguments record no path, and a controller class declared in several describe blocks of one spec refuses with shadowed-declaration.

reading: An edge is recorded only when the receiver binds to the framework import, the member is a listed verb, and the handler is a bound name or the decorated definition; a literal first argument becomes the path. On the one corpus with a runtime route table every osnova verb edge is true and every runtime route is covered.
